summary: Google's AI brain for the next generation of robots Discussion | Link
content: Gemini Robotics 2 is Google DeepMind’s latest step toward intelligent robots that can understand, reason, and act in the physical world. Powered by advanced Gemini models, it brings whole-body intelligence, dexterous manipulation, and adaptive reasoning to robots of different shapes and sizes. From complex physical tasks to multi-robot collaboration, Gemini Robotics 2 moves us closer to a future where robots can work alongside humans.
chineseSummary: 谷歌下一代机器人的人工智能大脑讨论|关联
chineseContent: Gemini Robotics 2 是 Google DeepMind 朝着能够在物理世界中理解、推理和行动的智能机器人迈出的最新一步。它由先进的 Gemini 模型提供支持，为不同形状和大小的机器人带来全身智能、灵巧的操作和自适应推理。从复杂的物理任务到多机器人协作，Gemini Robotics 2 让我们更接近机器人可以与人类一起工作的未来。
